title: AI Receptionist for Home Service Pros

blocks.heading: Never Miss Another *Job Call*
blocks.lead: AI answers every call 24/7, texts missed callers back instantly, and books the job straight into your calendar. While you're on the tools, nothing slips through.

items.title: My phone rang while I was under a sink.
items.body: By the time you called back, the customer had already hired the guy who picked up.

items.title: Weekend jobs go to whoever answers first.
items.body: After-hours calls hit voicemail. Most callers hang up and call your competitor instead.

items.title: I pay for ads, then miss the calls.
items.body: Every click costs money. Every missed call is that money thrown straight in the trash.

items.title: Nobody follows up with quotes.
items.body: Quotes sit unsent because you're on a job. The customer moves on while you're still working.

header.title: One system that *answers, qualifies, books*
header.subtitle: No receptionist to hire. No hardware. It runs on your existing phone number, around the clock.

items.title: AI Answers Instantly
items.body: Every call picked up on the first ring, 24/7. The AI greets your caller, understands the job — leak, outage, install — and collects name, number, and address.

items.title: Books Into Your Calendar
items.body: The job is scheduled in real time based on your availability and synced to your calendar or job software. No double-booking, no phone tag.

items.title: Texts Back & Follows Up
items.body: Missed call? They get a text in seconds. Estimates sent automatically. Review requests and repeat-visit reminders run on autopilot.

blocks.math: 10 missed calls/week × 20% would-have-booked × $450 avg job = *~$3,900/month recovered*
blocks.assumptions: Assumptions: 10 missed or voicemail calls per week; 1 in 5 would have booked a job; average job value $450. Your numbers will differ — the free audit maps your actual call volume.
blocks.disclaimer: Illustrative estimate for example purposes only. Actual results vary by trade, market, and call volume.

items.title: USA-Based Team
items.body: Real humans, real support, your timezone.

items.title: SMB-Friendly Pricing
items.body: Built for shops of 1–20 people, not enterprises.

items.title: Live in Days
items.body: Most systems up and running within 1–2 weeks.

items.title: Works With Your Tools
items.body: Connects to your existing calendar, CRM, and job software.

items.title: No Long-Term Contracts
items.body: Month-to-month. If it doesn't pay for itself, walk away.

header.title: See exactly where *jobs are leaking*
header.subtitle: A 30-minute working session — not a sales pitch. You leave with a fixed-quote plan whether or not you hire us.

items.title: Call Flow Map
items.body: We trace every missed call, unsent quote, and dead follow-up in your current setup — and put a dollar figure on it.

items.title: Fixed-Quote Plan
items.body: You get an exact scope, timeline, and price for the system that plugs the leaks. No hourly billing, no surprises.

items.title: Zero Commitment
items.body: Keep the plan and implement it yourself, or hand it to us. The audit is free either way.

items.a: It depends on scope — a solo plumber's setup looks very different from a 15-truck HVAC company. The free audit gives you a fixed quote before you spend anything.
No. We connect to your existing calendar, CRM, and job-management tools. If you don't have any, we'll set up simple ones for you.

items.q: How fast can this be live?
items.a: Most systems are up and running in 1–2 weeks, including testing against your actual call flow.
You never touch code. Once it's live, the system runs itself — you just answer the booked jobs that show up in your calendar.

blocks.heading: Stop leaving *money on the table.*
blocks.body: One saved job can pay for a month of automation. Get your free audit and see exactly where your calls are going.

seo.metaDescription: AI answers every call 24/7, texts missed callers back instantly, and books jobs into your calendar. Free automation audit for plumbers, HVAC & electricians.
